notes: Picked with BirdNET GeoModel (v3.0.4), run for a normal 2 to 3 week trip to Honshu: Tokyo and the Kanto parks and wetlands (Tokyo Port Wild Bird Park, Yatsu and Sanbanze tidal flats, Shinjuku Gyoen), Karuizawa, Mt Fuji and the Japan Alps, Kyoto, Osaka and Hiroshima (areas.json). A bird is in when its best-month score over those places is at least 0.25 (about 150 birds): the garden and city birds (Brown-eared Bulbul, Large-billed Crow, Eurasian Tree Sparrow, Japanese White-eye, Japanese Pygmy Woodpecker, Asian Tit, Varied Tit), the winter ducks and gulls of the bays, the shorebirds of the Tokyo mudflats, and the forest summer visitors of Karuizawa and the Alps (flycatchers, Japanese Thrush, Japanese Grosbeak). Hand-added because the model scores them low although a visitor can find them: Copper Pheasant (endemic), Japanese Accentor, Japanese Robin, Yellow-billed Grosbeak, Japanese Leaf Warbler. Left to the packs, which win over the country rule: Hokkaido (cranes, eagles, sea ducks, auks, northern woodpeckers and owls), Kyushu and Tsushima (cranes at Izumi, Black-faced Spoonbill, Saunders's Gull), the Ryukyu Islands (all island endemics), Izu and Ogasawara (seabirds, Izu Thrush, Bonin White-eye). Left out on purpose: introduced birds the model rates below 0.4 that are not part of a normal trip (Mute Swan, Common Pheasant, Red Junglefowl, Muscovy Duck, Black Swan), rare and scarce migrants. The model has no view on the small-island endemics (Okinawa Rail scores 0.04), so the island packs are hand-picked from eBird species lists per region. Not in the trip because Japan has no row for them in the country species table yet: Vega Gull (veggul1) and Siberian Pipit (sibpip1), both common winter birds of Tokyo Bay and the fields; add them to CountrySpecies and then to this list. Photos are review-agent picks from unreviewed candidates (not approved on production): check them on /trip-photos. Shaky picks: Japanese Sparrowhawk (ID uncertain vs Shikra/Chinese Sparrowhawk; few clear photos); Asian House Martin (possible confusion with Northern House Martin); Copper Pheasant (low-quality camera-trap/small images; best available); Eastern Buzzard (plumage variable; mostly flight shots); Eastern Red-rumped Swallow (skipped heavily-streaked 1185930/1185924 (possible Striated Swallow)); Long-billed Plover (most candidates are Black-fronted Dotterel/Little Ringed Plover; 310139 is a pale-legged long-billed type, moderate confidence); Brown-eared Bulbul (all candidates are mediocre distant/backlit shots); Japanese Thrush (ID/quality doubts; female/young types, few clean photos); White-bellied Green-Pigeon (only 6 usable; skipped 196825 (flight, possible Wedge-tailed)); Japanese Cormorant (Japanese vs Great Cormorant not fully certain); Asian Tit (Asian/Japanese Tit plumage types mixed); Japanese Leaf Warbler (leaf warbler ID hard from photos); Brown-headed Thrush (similar to Pale/Eyebrowed Thrush; some doubt); Lesser Cuckoo (cuckoo ID doubt (Lesser vs Oriental/Himalayan)); Eastern Marsh Harrier (only flight shots); Pale Thrush (ID doubt; mediocre photos); Yellow-billed Grosbeak (1056835 possible female, less sure).
